purpose: Express a deep and continuing wish or feeling.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
express feelings speak politely show respect
I sincerely wish you all good health.
I have an abiding love for my hometown.
I earnestly hope for the research to succeed.
restrictions: Usually with 願う, 祈る, 愛する, or 尊敬する.
mistake: It describes sustained feeling, not an action repeatedly attempted.
